top_story: Trump’s 23 March threat to destroy Iran’s power grid if Tehran kept the Strait of Hormuz closed sharpened a coercive cycle that Iranian leaders answered with explicit warnings of wider regional escalation. By 10 April, that escalation had visibly spilled into Lebanon, where continued Israeli strikes on Beirut after the announced ceasefire in the Iran war had killed more than 300 people and turned central neighborhoods into rubble fields. Gaza reflects the same enduring pattern of civilian exposure, with Israeli fire killing a nine-year-old girl inside her classroom and collapsing any distinction between front line and daily life. The regional picture is one of expanding conflict in which deterrent signaling by states is translating into sustained harm for urban civilians from Beirut to Gaza.
